title: Snowflake Event Partnership Opportunities
text: We are excited to announce that Snowflake Summit 2027 will return to Moscone Center in San Francisco from June 7-10, 2027! Showcase your solutions, elevate your brand, and network with 20,000 customers, industry peers, partners and Snowflake experts during our can’t-miss, four-day event for AI, apps and data. Summit offers unparalleled visibility to our joint customers and prospects across industries. Join us to experience the latest advancements across generative AI and machine learning, application development and so much more through hundreds of educational opportunities alongside the AI Data Cloud community.
